post.caption: In 1476 Mary of Burgundy sent a diamond to the Habsburgs, and in 1477 an adviser told Maximilian to have a ring set with a diamond ready. They married in person at Ghent on August 19, 1477. Many call hers the first diamond engagement ring, though an Italian lord gave one in 1475, and tradition says it held flat diamonds shaped like an M.
